name: Owen Morris — parents named as John and Dorothy Morris in the 1871 Cardiganshire census
researcher_question: Who were the parents of Owen Morris, born about 1859 (Newtown, Montgomeryshire, per the 1911 census), a roller leather finisher and later antique furniture collector in Cyfoeth-y-brenin (Borth), Cardiganshire, who married Ellen Elizabeth in 1882?
notes: Record-hint fixture (filtered-list-samples-4.csv row 28, hint-samples.csv row 978, flags adds_father/adds_mother, confidence 3). Draft transcribed from an 1871 Cardiganshire census household; unverified. The tree's own 1891 census source names a different father (Owen Morris Senr) and the 1911 census a different birthplace, so a false match is the likely outcome.
